PluginData.Author: Nerd e1
PluginData.Tooltip: Allows for copy pasting and saving/loading block custom data.
PluginData.Description:
Adds the following terminal/toolbar actions to every terminal block: - Copy Custom Data: Copies the block's custom data - Paste Custom Data: Pastes the last copied custom data - Clear Custom Data: Clears the block's custom data - Save Custom Data Profile w/ a text box: Saves the block's custom data into a named profile, persists between worlds. - Load Custom Data Profile w/ a dropdown: Loads the block's custom data from the given named profile, persists between worlds. - Delete Custom Data Profile: Deletes the selected named profile.
Also has a terminal toggle to enable/disable showing the toolbar actions to avoid clutter (terminal controls unaffected).
